source.ephemeris: JPL Horizons API (DE441), 10-min steps interpolated to 1 min
source.visibility_rule: Sun: visible when any part of the disc is above the terrain skyline
source.earth_link_rule: Earth link (two-way): a NASA DSN 70 m dish (Goldstone, Canberra, Madrid) is above the lander's terrain skyline and the lander is at least 10 deg above the dish's horizon (DSN 810-005 module 101: no transmission below 10 deg). Receive-only uses 6 deg (module 302: lowest pointing angle)
source.terrain: LOLA LDEM_60S_60M to 30 km; LOLA LDEM_60S_240M to 150 km

reasons: Some sunlight with Earth contact, but limited
verdict.rules: PROVISIONAL until T26: good if both-up >= 40% and longest both-window >= 72 h; marginal if any both-up time; else poor

notes: Skyline every 0.05° from: LOLA LDEM_60S_60M to 30 km; LOLA LDEM_60S_240M to 150 km.
Visibility checked every minute: Horizons positions every 10 min, interpolated to 1 min; rise and set times are interpolated to the second.
Windows shorter than 1 hour are listed as short windows (brief flashes of light or Earth).
